name: flareskill-monorepo
description: Open-source registry and CLI for discovering, installing, sharing, and managing reusable AI agent skills.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flareskill/skill-schema && npm run build -w @flareskill/skill-parser && npm run build -w @flareskill/skill-validator && npm run build -w @flareskill/registry-client && npm run build -w @flareskill/agent-adapters && npm run build -w flareskill
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test -w flareskill -- src/e2e.test.ts
scripts.validate:skills: npm run build && node apps/cli/dist/index.js validate ./skills
